messages:
maria: Heads-up — prepping the private/VPC installer bundle for v1.3.7-hotfix. Need quick integrity + signoff on the staging shrinkwrap before we promote to canary.
ivan: Which cosign key are we planning to use? last-week rotation made me nervous.
tara: @ivan we documented ops-cosign-key-02 as the new signer in runbook. asia mirror still showing lag earlier today.
kevin: I saw the mirror lag. Kicked a resync at 11:44 UTC, may take a few mins. If parity != 3/3, hold the promote.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] enqueue promote request: tag=private-installer-v1.3.7-hotfix target=staging window=2026-03-22T02:00Z initiator=maria
maria: Quick checklist I'm running: deterministic gzip, sha256 sum, cosign verify. Example I ran locally:
```
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz && cosign verify --key ksm://ops/cosign-02 bundle.tar.gz.sig
```
jen: bundle checksum differs by 1 byte vs registry copy — likely gzip timestamp variance. Rebuild with deterministic gzip (`gzip -n`) then re-sign.
ivan: good call @jen. Rebuild + re-sign required. Don't promote until that's done.
maria: rebuilding now with `gzip -n` and repackaging. will re-run cosign and push new manifest. holding promotion.
kevin: resync status: mirror parity = 3/3, sizes match. resync completed at 11:52 UTC.
ops-bot: [ops-bot] INFO: cosign key ops-cosign-key-02 metadata: expiry=2027-01-01, rotated_by=security@redwood.com, verified=true
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight checks pending: signatures_ok? mirror_parity? shrinkwrap_checksum_match?
maria: preflight now: signatures_ok=yes, mirror_parity=yes, checksum_match=yes after gzip -n rebuild. ready to proceed.
ivan: 👍 please confirm rollback policy. We want canary=2 nodes for 30m, auto-rollback if 5xx > 3% OR error_rate spike on health checks.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] action=promote target=staging canary_nodes=2 canary_window=30m rollback_policy="5xx>3% || health_check_fail"
jen: monitoring: alerts wired to #incidents and on-call pager. I'll watch the 30m window.
maria: launching promote now. will post status updates. if mirror parity breaks during window -> abort and republish with deterministic gzip.
kevin: ack. I'm standing by in case we need to force-unpin and republish.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary started successfully (2 nodes). observing metrics for 30m. auto-rollback enabled.
maria: thanks all — leaving final note: after canary green we'll schedule production promotion in the next permissive window (24h cooldown). if anything looks off, escalate and we'll roll back to v1.3.6 immediately.
